about: Sprite-sheet layout for /assets/vfx/itch. Frames are row-major from the TOP-LEFT cell; frame i is at col = i % cols, row = floor(i / cols). With three.js (flipY = true): texture.repeat.set(1/cols, 1/rows); texture.offset.set(col/cols, 1 - (row+1)/rows). Use NearestFilter + generateMipmaps=false for the PSX look.
